coach.intro: Compares your games with other players of your race in the same kind of game, from every replay you've analyzed. It only points out differences that show up in most of your games. Treat it as a hint, not a rule: builds and the meta change what's right.
coach.lastGameCheck_one: Your last game ({{result}} on {{map}}, {{date}}) reached {{hit}} of {{count}}.
coach.lastGameCheck_other: Your last game ({{result}} on {{map}}, {{date}}) reached {{hit}} of {{count}}.
coach.lossesHelp: Every number from the first 8 minutes, in your typical win and your typical loss. Red marks the ones that differ enough to matter, biggest first. They go together with losing, which doesn't mean they cause it.
coach.lossesNeed: Comparing needs {{needed}} wins and {{needed}} losses here. So far: {{wins}} and {{losses}}.
coach.lossesSame: These games don't have numbers from the first 8 minutes to compare.
coach.lowerFloor: Lowering the EAPM floor at the top counts more of them.
coach.noGaps: Nothing stands out. You're close to other players on everything the coach checks.
coach.noGoals: Nothing stands out against other players right now. Keep playing your game: the notes and the tables below show where you're closest to slipping.
coach.noneOfKind: None of your analyzed games are of this kind yet.
coach.noNotes: Nothing to say yet. Notes come once there are wins and losses to compare, and earlier games to compare your latest ones with.
coach.noStrengths: Nothing clearly ahead of other players yet.

note.formDown: {{wins}} wins and {{losses}} losses in your last {{count}}, {{rate}}, down from {{earlierRate}} before. Pick one goal for your next game and play a few games with only that in mind.
note.formSteady: {{wins}} wins and {{losses}} losses in your last {{count}}, {{rate}}, about the same as the {{earlierRate}} before. To move up, work on the goals for your next game.
note.formUp: {{wins}} wins and {{losses}} losses in your last {{count}}, {{rate}}, up from {{earlierRate}} before. Whatever changed, keep doing it.
note.improving: {{metric}}: {{recent}} lately, from {{earlier}} before. The practice is paying off.
note.inLosses: {{metric}}: {{win}} in your typical win, {{loss}} in your typical loss. It goes together with losing, so getting it right is worth more than anything else here.
note.slipping: {{metric}}: {{recent}} lately, from {{earlier}} before. Watch it in your next games before it becomes a habit.
note.strength: {{metric}}: {{you}} against {{them}}, better than {{percent}} of {{race}} players here. Lean on it.
note.timingEarly: You start {{build}} {{time}} earlier than most. Make sure it pays for what it costs elsewhere.
note.timingLate: You start {{build}} {{time}} later than most. If your build doesn't call for that, it's free time to win back.

coach.recentNeeds_other: Once you have {{count}} more games here, this compares your latest ones with the ones before.
coach.recentNoNumbers: These games don't have enough numbers in common to compare.
coach.sameOpening: Compared with players who opened the same way.
coach.skipped_one: {{count}} more of yours is left out, since someone left in the first 5 minutes.
coach.skipped_other: {{count}} more of yours are left out, since someone left in the first 5 minutes.
coach.timingsHelp: When you and other players usually start each building, tech and upgrade in the first 15 minutes, in build order. A dash means that side makes it in too few games. Bold differences are far enough apart to matter. Earlier isn't always better: it depends on your build.

tip.army: Your army is smaller than most at this point. Keep every production building busy and spend your money on units.
tip.armyTrade: You lose more than you kill in fights. Fight where your units are strong, wait for your upgrades, and pull back from fights you're losing.
tip.bank: When money piles up, spend it right away: queue units, add {{production}}, or take another base.
tip.base: Plan your next {{townHall}} at a set supply in your build, and take it even when you feel unsafe. A late base holds back everything after it.
tip.hotkeys: Put your army and your production on hotkeys, and use them instead of clicking on the screen.
tip.income: Mining follows workers and bases. Fill each base with {{workers}}, take your gas on time, and expand before your main runs dry.
tip.overlordsLost: Spread your Overlords out, away from the paths your opponent's army and air units take.
tip.production: Add {{production}} sooner, so your money turns into units instead of sitting in the bank.
tip.productionCommands: Produce more steadily: check every production building each time you cycle through your hotkeys.
tip.speed: Speed comes from habits. Cycle through your bases and production with hotkeys, even when nothing's happening.
tip.supply: To max out sooner, keep making {{workers}} and add production as your income grows.
tip.supplyBlocked: Build {{supply}} ahead of time. Start one whenever you get within about 8 supply of your cap, and two at once once you have a lot of production.
tip.workers: Keep your {{townHalls}} making {{workers}} without a break. Queue one or two, and check on them every time you cycle through your hotkeys.
tip.workersLost: Protect your mineral lines. Keep a few units or some static defense near them, and pull {{workers}} away when harass comes.
